verdict.rationale: The pack documents an MCP server and integrations that let external agents such as Cursor, Claude Code and Codex CLI reach Shortcut data. That is a developer building block for outside tools, not AI-generated insights or suggestions inside the product. No evidence describes in-product AI analysis, insights or recommendations, and the 'idea to spec to PR' line is too vague to credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
